en_title: Elden Ring Movie Runtime Could Reach Nearly 3 Hours
cn_title: 《艾尔登法环》电影或长达近三小时
subtitle: 至少180页剧本
opus_summary: 据Deadline报道，《艾尔登法环》电影剧本含视觉内容至少180页，片长或接近三小时。影片将围绕主角的旅程展开，据称包含与怪物和巨龙交战的场面。

paragraphs.en: A few new details on the story for A24’s Elden Ring movie have emerged, including its possible runtime. And, if that remains the case, it’s going to be epic.
paragraphs.cn: A24出品的《艾尔登法环》电影又有一些剧情细节曝光，可能的片长也浮出水面。如果片长最终确实如此，这将是一部史诗级电影。

paragraphs.en: Deadline reports that writer-director Alex Garland’s screenplay , based on FromSoftware’s acclaimed fantasy video game, “runs to at least 180 pages with visuals, implying the movie could push towards three hours. While plot details are largely being kept under wraps, we understand that in-demand Heartstopper actor [Kit] Connor is the protagonist and the ‘faithful’ film will follow his journey. There are said to be battles between his character and impressive monsters and dragons.”
paragraphs.cn: 据Deadline报道，Alex Garland为这部电影编写的剧本「连同视觉内容在内至少有180页，表明影片时长可能接近3小时。虽然大部分剧情细节仍处于保密状态，但据我们了解，凭借《心跳漏一拍》走红、片约不断的演员Kit Connor将饰演主角，这部「忠于原作」的电影将围绕他的旅程展开。据称，他饰演的角色将与令人震撼的怪物和巨龙交战」。这部由Garland自编自导的电影，改编自From Software广受好评的奇幻游戏。

paragraphs.en: The site also claims that A24 is allowing potential international buyers to read Garland’s Elden Ring script, but only with a studio staff member present (for security reasons, naturally).
paragraphs.cn: 该网站还称，A24允许有意购买海外发行权的买家阅读Garland编写的《艾尔登法环》剧本，但必须有一名公司工作人员在场，当然，这是出于保密考虑。

paragraphs.en: It was reported last week that the Elden Ring movie is the most expensive film A24 has ever produced – Deadline’s report today pegs it at “between $175 million-200 million, but closer to the latter” – and now comes word that the studio, which fully financed the film, is looking to mitigate some of that risk by bringing in a partner with very deep pockets: Amazon.
paragraphs.cn: 上周有报道称，《艾尔登法环》是A24迄今制作成本最高的电影。Deadline今天的报道将成本定在「1.75亿至2亿美元(约合人民币13亿元)，但更接近后者」。如今又有消息称，全额出资拍摄该片的A24正寻求引入财力雄厚的合作伙伴亚马逊，以分担部分风险。

paragraphs.en: According to Deadline, Amazon MGM Studios has now acquired “a bunch of international pay-1 streaming rights... The pact is understood to cover a large number of international markets, and sources speculate to us that it is easily worth tens of millions of dollars. We hear the deal could also potentially lead to interesting activations on Amazon’s Twitch platform.”
paragraphs.cn: 据Deadline报道，亚马逊米高梅影业已购得「多个海外市场的首轮付费流媒体播放权……据了解，这份协议覆盖大量海外市场，消息人士向我们推测，协议价值轻松达到数千万美元(约合人民币金额待核实)。我们还听说，这笔交易也可能促成亚马逊旗下Twitch平台上的一些有趣的联动活动」。

paragraphs.en: The film’s huge price tag makes Elden Ring one of the most expensive films that will be shopped at next month’s American Film Market, which touts itself as “the premier marketplace for the acquisition, development, financing, and distribution of independent film, television, and premium content for audiences worldwide.”
paragraphs.cn: 高昂的制作成本使《艾尔登法环》成为下个月美国电影市场上待售影片中成本最高的作品之一。该活动自称是「面向全球观众，供独立电影、电视节目及优质内容开展版权收购、开发、融资和发行业务的首要交易市场」。

paragraphs.en: Potential buyers at AFM will reportedly be treated to an Elden Ring movie presentation of some kind, including possibly seeing the very first footage from this highly-anticipated film.
paragraphs.cn: 据报道，参加美国电影市场（AFM）的潜在买家将有机会观看某种形式的《艾尔登法环》电影展示，其中可能包括这部备受期待的影片首次公开的影像片段。

paragraphs.en: After some set photos made their way online , Elden Ring wrapped filming in July and is scheduled to open in theaters on March 3, 2028.
paragraphs.cn: 在部分片场照片流传到网上后，《艾尔登法环》电影于7月杀青，定于2028年3月3日登陆院线。

paragraphs.en: In addition to Kit O’Connor, the cast includes Ben Whishaw, Cailee Spaeny, Tom Burke, Havana Rose Liu, Sonoya Mizuno, Jonathan Pryce, Nick Offerman and Peter Serafinowicz .
paragraphs.cn: 除Kit O’Connor外，参演演员还包括Ben Whishaw、Cailee Spaeny、Tom Burke、Havana Rose Liu、Sonoya Mizuno、Jonathan Pryce、Nick Offerman和Peter Serafinowicz。

paragraphs.en: Are you excited by the prospect of a three-hour Elden Ring movie? Let us know in the comments.
paragraphs.cn: 《艾尔登法环》电影可能长达三小时，你期待吗？欢迎在评论区告诉我们。

paragraphs.en: Jim Vejvoda (he/him) is IGN's Assoc. Director of Entertainment Content.
paragraphs.cn: Jim Vejvoda（代词：he/him）是IGN娱乐内容副总监。
